KUNAL GOSAVI Senior Network Engineer (Qualcomm) Bangalore|7083118084 | gamingforlife1121@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/kunal-gosavi-b529661b6

TECHNICAL SKILLS SET Networking: Routing & Switching, WAN, VXLAN, Data Center Networking Protocols: OSPF, EIGRP, BGP, STP, QoS, MPLS, IPSEC Technologies: vPC, MLAG, VXLAN EVPN Vendors: Cisco, Aruba, Arista Load Balancers: Citrix NetScaler (MPX/VPX), F5 LTM Wireless: Aruba, cisco [Monitoring only] Automation: Ansible, Jenkins Other: Network Troubleshooting, Design, Documentation, Deployment

CISCO Certifications - CCNA R&S (Cisco ID: CSCO13195601) (Exp in 2023) - CCNP R&S (Cisco ID: CSCO13195601) (Exp in 2023) - CCIE R&S (Written: EXP in 2023)

Devices worked on and training: - Cisco catalyst 2960, 2960-s, 3560, 3750, 3850, 3650, 3750-E, Nexus series-4500, 6500 5k 7K and 9k. - Cisco routers-2900, 800 series, 1000 and 2000 series, 4300 series, CSR 1000V, Some ASR series routers. - Arista DCS-7000 series - Citrix 3000/5900/7100 - BIG-IP Virtual Edition

Training: I-MEDITA (BANER, PUNE) CCNA R&S, CCNP R&S and CCIE R&S

EMPLOYMENT HISTORY Senior Network Engineer

Qualcomm (Sept 2025 – Currently working)

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Manage and support enterprise and data center network infrastructure using Cisco, Aruba, and Arista platforms. - Handle daily operational tasks, including incident response, troubleshooting outages, and resolving network issues. - Perform installations, upgrades, and configuration changes on Arista switches/routers and load balancers (Citrix & F5). - Support global network deployments, including implementation of data center routers and switches. - Collaborate with cross-functional teams and business units to gather requirements and deliver scalable solutions. - Work extensively with protocols: OSPF, EIGRP, BGP, STP, QoS, and technologies like VXLAN and MLAG/vPC. - Utilize Ansible and Jenkins for network automation and device provisioning. - Lead and contribute to technology refresh projects, upgrading end-of-life network devices. - Create detailed network documentation, topology diagrams, and cutover plans.

KEY PROJECTS San Diego Data Center Bring-up - Participated in deployment of 16 leaf and 4 spine architecture during global shutdown. Cumulus to Arista Migration - Successfully migrated ~100 switches from Cumulus to Arista infrastructure. Arista EOS Upgrade - Led upgrade of Arista switches to 4.32M OS version ensuring minimal downtime. Load Balancer Upgrades - Performed Citrix MPX/VPX and F5 OS upgrades across environments. VLAN Renumbering Project - Executed renumbering of 30 VLANs in San Diego data center with proper planning and validation.

Technical Consulting Engineer

Capgemini (Sept 2022- Sept 2025) | Bengaluru (WFH) - Troubleshooting as first line for any outages in the network and any network

related issues.

Monitoring and maintenance of network devices such as Cisco Routers, Switches & Data Canter devices such as Nexus switches, ASR devices. - Co- ordinating with Telco/Last mile providers for end-to-end connectivity & maintaining customer’s network uptime.

Work as a break fix for end user issue related to AnyConnect VPN and home office equipment, wireless.

Performing configuration on Nexus 9k series switches during migration.

Configuring CPE routers for HSRP, NAT. doing fail-over testing. - Experience in troubleshooting networking products such as Wireless devices, AP, controller etc. by using Splunk, WLC, DNAC.

Perform necessary checks, apply monitoring tools and respond to alerts.

Configuring & Troubleshooting PE routers for MPLS (LDP & L3VPNs). - Configuring BGP (best path manipulation, communities, route-filtering as per customer needs) on both PE and CPE routers.

As per customer need doing traffic engineering/route manipulation at PE side. - Configuring Eigrp/OSPF/BGP as a PE-CE routing protocol. Also performing distribution on PE routers. - Currently working with ISPs like AT&T, Verizon, Vodafone Emea with 40gig & 100Gig links. - Preparing network design document (SNDD) for upcoming migrations with help of MS Visio - Preparing device configuration templates (SMOP)for upcoming migrations - Working with team during Cisco migrations.

Network Analyst Engineer GTT| Pune - Worked on layer-1 media like Copper and Fiber. - Have experience in DSL technologies like Ethernet over copper, DIA, ATM,

MDNX, ACI.

Providing first-line investigation and diagnosis using approved tools, systems and procedures.

Resolving/fulfilling incidents/service requests that are in scope. - Engaging and arranging external technical and non-technical support where hands and eyes support are required on-site.

Following-up with external technical and non-technical support organizations including 3rd parties until incident/request resolution/fulfilment. - Understanding of and familiarity with Customers’ services and solutions.

Network Associate Engineer Airtel| Hyderabad - Configuring & Troubleshooting PE routers for VRF and MPLS. - Configuring BGP (best path manipulation, communities, route-filtering) on

both PE and CPE routers.

Configuring Eigrp/OSPF/BGP as a PE-CE routing protocol. - Performing redistribution on PE routers.

As per customer need doing traffic engineering/route manipulation at PE side.

Doing packet level trouble-shoot in ISP core routers. - Configuring QOS policers and shapers as per allocated bandwidth values.

Configuring CPE routers for HSRP, NAT. doing failover testing. - Making sure fast route convergence by configuring BFD between PECPE. - Monitoring customer (Airtel-primary, VI-Secondary) links, if down/flapped raising fault tickets for same and handing escalations. - Fetching bandwidth utilization reports every two hour for customer links, if observed high then troubleshooting for same.

Performing maintenance activities on CPE routers. - Coordinating with team for transmission issues. - Monitoring CPE routers with SNMP. - SOFTWARES: Wireshark, GNS, Putty and Secure CRT.

Network Associate Engineer Tata Communications Ltd| Bengaluru

Working in protocols like BGP, OSPF, Eigrp and Static Routing.

Configuring Policers on PE and Shapers on CPE

Checking readiness of ISP core routers before performing configuration activity on CPE.

Configuring HSRP.VRRP and GLBP for redundant default gateway - Monitoring

customer routers with IP SLA, SNMP.

Performing activities on CPE routers within given time frame - Features like

Multicasting.

Handling Customer Escalations.

Junior Associate Wipro Limited | Pune - Experience in routing protocols like RIP, BGP. - Configuring new Routers at CPE site. - Experience in VRF, GRE. - Prechecking PE routers before CPE configuration. - Taking Access of Routers with the help of Field engineer.

EDUCTION July 2016 BE (Computer Engineering) Amrutvahini College Of Engineering,Sangamner

STRENGTHS - Good Communication Skill - Well time management - Positive Attitude - Dedication about work

Function under pressure

EXTRA CURRICULAR ACTIVITIES 1. Participated in paper presentation at CONNOISSEUR-2K15 2. Participated in Hack-Tricks National level workshop 3. I-phone application Development workshop 4. Proficiency in C-programming workshop
